div.div: Databases dominate (88% of 1×); its 20× figure depends on the ledger posting-rate measurement. Networking and Monitoring are the super-linear drivers (NAT data processing, log/trace ingestion) — bent down with VPC endpoints, lower X-Ray sampling, Savings Plans and Aurora reserved capacity.
